newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM sees higher feedstock costs in Q4.
newsitem.headline: DSM sees higher feedstock costs in Q4.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday its fourth quarter 1996 results would be affected by higher feedstock costs and several planned maintenance shutdowns.
"We expect the supply and demand situation for our major products to remain good during the coming months," DSM said in a statement.
However, fourth quarter results would be affected by higher feedstock costs -- mainly for naphtha -- and by several planned maintenance shutdowns, it added.
"We expect that it will only be possible to pass on a part of the increase in feedstock costs via the prices of our products," DSM said.
"All things considered, we maintain our previous forecast that 1996 will be a good year," DSM added.
